# Wild & Co Voyages
> Small-ship voyages and whole-yacht charters chosen by James Wild & Co. (journey design since 1982, Miami, FL; FL Seller of Travel ST45327). Every vessel and voyage carries a permanent Ledger ID and a mark showing how well James knows her.

## Destinations
- [Galápagos](https://jameswildco.com/voyages/galapagos.html): 11 vessels, 16–20 guests, 5–15 days; Royal Galapagos, Ecoventura, Vianatura's Hermes.
- [Raja Ampat & Komodo](https://jameswildco.com/voyages/raja-ampat.html): the phinisi Aliikai, 14 guests, four routes from US$3,795 pp, or the whole yacht.
